items.source:
Register a global error for the entire target object,
using the given error description.
items.translation: 使用给定的错误描述，为整个目标对象注册一个全局错误。

items.source: errorCode - error code, interpretable as a message key
items.translation: errorCode - 错误代码，可解释为消息键

items.source: field - the field name
items.translation: field - 字段名称

items.source: defaultMessage - fallback default message
items.translation: defaultMessage - 回退默认消息

items.source: The field name may be null or empty String to indicate the current object itself rather than a field of it. This may result in a corresponding field error within the nested object graph or a global error if the current object is the top object.
items.translation: 字段名可以为 `null` 或空字符串，以表示当前对象本身而非其某个字段。这可能导致嵌套对象图中出现相应的字段错误，或者如果当前对象是顶层对象，则会出现全局错误。

items.source:
Register a field error for the specified field of the current object
(respecting the current nested path, if any), using the given error
description.
items.translation: 为当前对象的指定字段注册一个字段错误（如有嵌套路径，则尊重当前的嵌套路径），使用给定的错误描述。

items.source: field - the field name (may be null or empty String)
items.translation: field - 字段名称（可为 null 或空字符串）

items.source: Field names are typically properties of the target object (for example, "name" when binding to a customer object). Implementations may also support nested fields in case of nested objects (for example, "address.street"), in conjunction with subtree navigation via setNestedPath(String): for example, an AddressValidator may validate "address", not being aware that this is a nested object of a top-level customer object.
items.translation: 字段名称通常是目标对象的属性（例如，绑定到客户对象时的"name"）。实现也可能支持嵌套对象中的嵌套字段（例如，"address.street"），并结合通过setNestedPath(String)进行的子树导航：例如，AddressValidator可以验证"address"，而无需知道这是一个顶级客户对象的嵌套对象。

items.source: A popNestedPath() call will reset the original nested path before the corresponding pushNestedPath(String) call.
items.translation: 一个 `popNestedPath()` 调用将在对应的`pushNestedPath(String)` 调用之前重置原始嵌套路径。

items.source: "." = same as the nested property separator in the beans package.
items.translation: "." 与 beans 包中的 nested property separator 相同。

items.source: The default implementation throws UnsupportedOperationException since not all Errors implementations support nested paths.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出UnsupportedOperationException，因为并非所有Errors实现都支持嵌套路径。

items.source: Note: Errors objects are single-threaded.
items.translation: 注意：Errors 对象是单线程的。

items.source: Get the first error associated with a field, if any.
items.translation: 获取与字段关联的第一个错误（如果有）。

items.source: Get the first global error, if any.
items.translation: 获取第一个全局错误（如果有）。

items.source: Throw the mapped exception with a message summarizing the recorded errors.
items.translation: 抛出带有记录错误摘要消息的映射异常。

items.source: Get all errors, both global and field ones.
items.translation: 获取所有错误，包括全局错误和字段错误。

items.source: Determine the total number of errors.
items.translation: 确定错误总数。

items.source: Get the first error associated with the given field, if any.
items.translation: 获取给定字段关联的第一个错误（如果有）。

items.source: Determine the number of errors associated with a field.
items.translation: 确定与字段关联的错误数量。

items.source: Determine the number of errors associated with the given field.
items.translation: 确定给定字段关联的错误数量。

items.source: Get all errors associated with a field.
items.translation: 获取与字段关联的所有错误。

items.source: Determine the number of global errors.
items.translation: 确定全局错误的数量。

items.source: Get all global errors.
items.translation: 获取所有全局错误。

items.source: Return the name of the bound root object.
items.translation: 返回绑定根对象的名称。

items.source: Determine if there were any errors.
items.translation: 确定是否出现任何错误。

items.source: Determine if there were any errors associated with a field.
items.translation: 确定是否与字段关联了任何错误。

items.source: Determine if there were any errors associated with the given field.
items.translation: 确定给定字段是否有任何关联的错误。

items.source: Determine if there were any global errors.
items.translation: 确定是否出现任何全局错误。

items.source: Pop the former nested path from the nested path stack.
items.translation: 从嵌套路径栈中弹出前一个嵌套路径。

items.source:
Return a summary of the recorded errors,
for example, for inclusion in an exception message.
items.translation: 返回已记录错误的摘要，例如用于包含在异常消息中。

items.source: messageToException - a function mapping the message to the exception, for example, IllegalArgumentException::new or IllegalStateException::new
items.translation: `messageToException` - 一个将消息映射到异常的功能，例如 `IllegalArgumentException::new` 或 `IllegalStateException::new`。

items.source: errorArgs - error arguments, for argument binding via MessageFormat (can be null)
items.translation: errorArgs - 错误参数，用于通过 MessageFormat 进行参数绑定（可为 null）

items.source: T - the exception type to be thrown
items.translation: T - 要抛出的异常类型

items.source: a List of FieldError instances
items.translation: 一个 `FieldError` 实例的列表

items.source: the field-specific error, or null
items.translation: 字段特定的错误，或null

items.source: This is a convenience method to avoid repeated reject(..) calls for merging an Errors instance into another Errors instance.
items.translation: 这是一个便捷方法，用于避免在将一个 `Errors` 实例合并到另一个 `Errors` 实例时重复调用 `reject(..)`。

items.source: The default implementation throws UnsupportedOperationException since not all Errors implementations support #addAllErrors.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出UnsupportedOperationException，因为并非所有Errors实现都支持#addAllErrors。

items.source: Note that the passed-in Errors instance is supposed to refer to the same target object, or at least contain compatible errors that apply to the target object of this Errors instance.
items.translation: 注意，传入的 `<code>Errors` 实例应指向同一个目标对象，或者至少包含适用于此 `<code>Errors` 实例的目标对象的兼容错误。

items.source: Implementations should be able to determine the type even when the field value is null, for example from some associated descriptor.
items.translation: 实现应能够确定类型，即使字段值为 `null`，例如从某些关联的描述符中。

items.source:
For example, an address validator could validate the subobject
"address" of a customer object.
items.translation: 例如，地址验证器可以验证客户对象的子对象“address"。

items.source:
Returns a nested path with a dot, i.e. "address.", for easy
building of concatenated paths. Default is an empty String.
items.translation: 返回一个带有点的嵌套路径，即"address."，以便于构建连接的路径。默认值为空字符串。

items.source:
Using the nested path stack allows to set temporary nested paths
for subobjects without having to worry about a temporary path holder.
items.translation: 使用嵌套路径栈可以为子对象设置临时嵌套路径，而无需担心临时路径持有器。

items.source:
For example: current path "spouse.", pushNestedPath("child") →
result path "spouse.child."; popNestedPath() → "spouse." again.
items.translation: 例如：当前路径 "spouse."，执行 `pushNestedPath("child")` → 结果路径为 "spouse.child."；执行 `popNestedPath()` → 再次变为 "spouse."。

items.source:
Implementations may support not only full field names like
"address.street" but also pattern matches like "address.*".
items.translation: 实现可能不仅支持完整的字段名称（如"address.street"），还支持模式匹配（如"address.*"）。

items.source:
Allows for convenient access to user-specified field values,
even if there were type mismatches.
items.translation: 允许方便地访问用户指定的字段值，即使存在类型不匹配的情况。

items.source: Add all errors from the given Errors instance to this Errors instance.
items.translation: 将给定 `Errors` 实例中的所有错误添加到此 `Errors` 实例中。

items.source: Return the current nested path of this Errors object.
items.translation: 返回此Errors对象的当前嵌套路径。

items.source:
The separator between path elements in a nested path,
for example in "customer.name" or "customer.address.street".
items.translation: 嵌套路径中路径元素之间的分隔符，例如在"customer.name"或"customer.address.street"中。

items.source: Get all errors associated with the given field.
items.translation: 获取给定字段的所有错误。

items.source: Determine the type of the given field, as far as possible.
items.translation: 尽可能确定给定字段的类型。

items.source:
Return the current value of the given field, either the current
bean property value or a rejected update from the last binding.
items.translation: 返回给定字段的当前值，即当前的 Bean 属性值或上一次绑定中拒绝的更新。

items.source: Push the given sub path onto the nested path stack.
items.translation: 将给定的子路径推送到嵌套路径栈上。

items.source:
Allow context to be changed so that standard validators can validate
subtrees.
items.translation: 允许更改上下文，以便标准验证器可以验证子树。

items.source: a list of ObjectError/FieldError instances
items.translation: 一个 `ObjectError` /`FieldError` 实例列表

items.source: toString in class Object
items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中

items.source: nestedPath - nested path within this object, for example, "address" (defaults to "", null is also acceptable). Can end with a dot: both "address" and "address." are valid.
items.translation: `nestedPath` - 此对象内的嵌套路径，例如 "address"（默认为 ""，null 也可接受）。可以以点结尾："address" 和 "address." 均有效。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if there is no former nested path on the stack
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果栈上没有之前的嵌套路径

items.source: errors - the Errors instance to merge in
items.translation: errors - 要合并的 Errors 实例

items.source: a list of ObjectError instances
items.translation: 一个 `ObjectError` 实例的列表，类在 org.springframework.validation中。

items.source: subPath - the sub path to push onto the nested path stack
items.translation: subPath - 要推入嵌套路径栈的子路径

items.source: the global error, or null
items.translation: 全局错误，或null

items.source: the type of the field, or null if not determinable
items.translation: 该字段的类型，或如果无法确定则为null。

items.source: Rod Johnson, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Rod Johnson，Juergen Hoeller

items.source: the current value of the given field
items.translation: 给定字段的当前值

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
